items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: I heard a record of that by a guy named Henry Sims I think. Did you ever hear of him?

ctx.x: Yeah. That's You Don't Know My Mind.
Oh yeah. I heard a record of that by a guy named Henry Sims I think. Did you ever hear of him?
No, I didn't know where you are then, but I used to play that all the time.
